The ARM64 SIMD accuracy, vector-tail bit identity, signed-zero/infinity/NaN edges, objdump instruction proof, default/pure-SIMD/cgo-SIMD CPU suites, cross-architecture compilation, downstream Mamba/autograd tests, six-pair alternating self benchmark, and local PyTorch L1 comparison all satisfy the approved task. ARM64 SIMD F64 SiLU now uses a two-lane NEON leaf. Whole-operation PyTorch still leads 1.15x, localizing the next bottom-up target to L0 output allocation. The repository-wide SIMD nlp failures reproduce with this gate disabled.
